hypothesis: The moving-average/short-channel exits whipsaw positions and reenter late. Track each stock's observed peak while risk is open and observed trough while closed; exit on a declared drawdown and restore on a declared reversal. No retrospective extrema or date keys.

fixed_rules.closed_risk: ratchet trough, reenter when close/trough-1 >= reentry_rebound and five-session return is positive
fixed_rules.eligibility: positive multi-horizon log momentum and an open directional state
fixed_rules.allocation: same independent persistent unit allocation and cash reuse as declared participation experiment

selection_objective: mean(log(wealth / matched buy_hold wealth) - 0.75 * max_drawdown - 0.002 * max(0, orders_per_year - 20))
execution: Unchanged parent cash-only next-session adjusted-unit replay; no same-close fills, invented stop fills, leverage or new accounting assumptions.
evidence: Keep every trial and failed predecessor. Training ranks candidates, not acceptance. Already-observed 2026 is retrospective. Preserve hashes of adapter, allocation dependency, runner, data and all traces. No arbitrary-subset dominance is inferred.
